mapper.select: SELECT pm.id as managementId, pm.process_instance_id, pm.process_definition_id, pm.business_id, pm.business_code, pm.business_key, pm.current_node_id, pm.process_status, pm.start_time, pm.end_time, pm.business_name, pm.approve_status, pm.act_process_definition_id, ptm.id AS taskManagementId, ptm.current_activity_id, ptm.task_id, ptm.current_approve_id, ptm.task_status, ptm.timeout_warn_status, ptm.timeout_warn_interval, ptm.timeout_handle_type, ptm.approve_time, ptm.remark, ptm.pre_activity_id, ptm.execution_id, ptm.current_activity_name from process_management pm , process_task_management ptm where pm.process_instance_id = ptm.process_instance_id AND approve_status = 'approveIng' AND pm.business_id = #{businessId} AND pm.business_key = #{businessKey} AND ptm.task_status = 'approveIng' AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ptm.create_time ASC LIMIT 1
